cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Plant Engineering Manager to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Develop, execute, and manage activities aimed at maintaining and improving asset availability and reliability. Direct and oversee assigned contractor personnel in activities relating to assigned projects. Support and ensure compliance with quality, environmental, business policies, and state standards. Identify and correct chronic, repetitive, and costly electrical equipment and systems problems. Obtain information necessary for design improvement where inherent reliability is inadequate. Provide engineering support as needed and be on-call for critical plant electrical or other systems failures. Improve equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost. Perform technical analysis, testing, calculations, and evaluation of results to solve complex engineering and reliability problems. cond_0012.responsibilities: Candidate must have experience to develop, execute and manage activities aimed at maintaining/improving asset availability and reliability. Manage capital equipment quoting, purchasing, installation and startup processes. Direct and oversee assigned contractor personnel in activities relating to the implementation of assigned projects. Obtain the information necessary for design improvement for equipment and systems where inherent reliability is inadequate. Improve equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost. Support all phases of facility expansions and modifications.
Collaborate on the management of plant Mechanical and Electrical support systems.
Help ensure all assigned projects are completed within the approved schedule and budget.
Coordinate capital equipment quoting, purchasing, installation, and startup processes.
Work with and oversee assigned contractor personnel in activities relating to the implementation of assigned projects.

Share responsibility for planning and monitoring capital investment expenditures.

Provide electrical engineering support to maintenance and operations teams.

Provide engineering support as needed and be available on-call for critical plant or asset electrical or other systems failures.

Collaborate on improving equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost.
Perform technical analysis, testing, calculations, and evaluation of results to help solve complex engineering and reliability problems.
Coordinate failure analysis of electrical and other systems and equipment, and share findings with maintenance and production technicians.
Maintain and update plant electrical drawings and files as needed.

cond_0120.intro: We are looking for a Plant Engineering Manager to join our team.
cond_0120.responsibilities: Candidate must have experience to develop, execute and manage activities aimed at maintaining/improving asset availability and reliability. Restore equipment to base condition— inherent levels of reliability and safety—when deterioration occurs. Assist in all phases of facility expansions and modifications. Management of plant Mechanical and Electrical support systems. Manage all assigned projects in a manner that will ensure completion within the approved project schedule and budget. Manage capital equipment quoting, purchasing, installation and startup processes. Direct and oversee assigned contractor personnel in activities relating to the implementation of assigned projects. Supports and ensures compliance with quality, environmental, business policies and state standards associates with such management systems. Develop standardized documentation including SOP's, training, and validation of equipment reliability. Responsible for planning and monitoring capital investment expenditures. Establishes key interfaces and builds relationships with internal customers and key team members in support of alignment of CAPEX project goals. Identify and manage relationships with preferred equipment manufacturers, specialists, and technical support consultants. Identify and correct chronic, repetitive, and costly electrical equipment and other systems problems. Support turnarounds planned and unplanned outages, major electrical equipment overhauls, routine, and non-routine repairs. Provide electrical engineering support to maintenance and operations teams. Obtain the information necessary for design improvement for equipment and systems where inherent reliability is inadequate. Provide engineering support as needed and be on-call for critical plant/asset electrical or other systems failures. Work closely with manufacturing teams at all levels to resolve technical issues, applying engineering and technical skills to design, optimize and troubleshoot electrical and other systems equipment. Improve equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost. Perform technical analysis, testing, calculations, and evaluation of results to solve complex engineering and reliability problems. Lead failure analysis of electrical and other systems/equipment and educate both maintenance and production technicians after failure analysis. Maintain and update plant electrical drawings and files as needed.

Around 5 years of technical experience in a production environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience with project management and environmental compliance; relevant exposure in either area is considered
Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is strongly preferred

Working knowledge of SAP is required

Restore equipment to base condition—inherent levels of reliability and safety—when deterioration occurs. Assist in all phases of facility expansions and modifications. Manage plant mechanical and electrical support systems. Manage all assigned projects to ensure completion within the approved schedule and budget. Manage capital equipment quoting, purchasing, installation, and startup processes. Direct and oversee assigned contractor personnel in activities relating to the implementation of assigned projects. Support and ensure compliance with quality, environmental, business policies, and state standards associated with such management systems. Develop standardized documentation including SOPs, training, and validation of equipment reliability. Plan and monitor capital investment expenditures. Establish key interfaces and build relationships with internal customers and key team members in support of alignment of CAPEX project goals. Identify and manage relationships with preferred equipment manufacturers, specialists, and technical support consultants. Identify and correct chronic, repetitive, and costly electrical equipment and other systems problems. Support turnarounds, planned and unplanned outages, major electrical equipment overhauls, and routine and non-routine repairs. Provide electrical engineering support to maintenance and operations teams. Obtain information necessary for design improvement for equipment and systems where inherent reliability is inadequate. Provide engineering support as needed and be on-call for critical plant/asset electrical or other systems failures. Work closely with manufacturing teams at all levels to resolve technical issues, applying engineering and technical skills to design, optimize, and troubleshoot electrical and other systems equipment. Improve equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost. Perform technical analysis, testing, calculations, and evaluation of results to solve complex engineering and reliability problems. Lead failure analysis of electrical and other systems/equipment and educate both maintenance and production technicians after failure analysis. Maintain and update plant electrical drawings and files as needed.
cond_0131.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5+ Years of technical experience in a production environment
Project management and environmental experience
SAP experience
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering
Continuous Improvement experience using LEAN or Six Sigma concepts

cond_0451.intro: We are looking for a Plant Engineering Manager to join our team.
cond_0451.responsibilities: Develop, execute, and manage activities aimed at maintaining and improving asset availability and reliability. Restore equipment to base condition when deterioration occurs. Assist in all phases of facility expansions and modifications. Manage plant mechanical and electrical support systems. Manage all assigned projects to ensure completion within the approved schedule and budget. Manage capital equipment quoting, purchasing, installation, and startup processes. Direct and oversee assigned contractor personnel in activities relating to assigned projects. Support and ensure compliance with quality, environmental, business policies, and state standards. Develop standardized documentation including SOPs, training, and validation of equipment reliability. Plan and monitor capital investment expenditures. Establish key interfaces and build relationships with internal customers and team members in support of CAPEX project goals. Identify and manage relationships with preferred equipment manufacturers, specialists, and technical support consultants. Identify and correct chronic, repetitive, and costly electrical equipment and systems problems. Support planned and unplanned outages, major electrical equipment overhauls, and routine and non-routine repairs. Provide electrical engineering support to maintenance and operations teams. Obtain information necessary for design improvement where inherent reliability is inadequate. Provide engineering support as needed and be on-call for critical plant electrical or other systems failures. Work closely with manufacturing teams at all levels to resolve technical issues, applying engineering skills to design, optimize, and troubleshoot electrical and other systems equipment. Improve equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost. Perform technical analysis, testing, calculations, and evaluation of results to solve complex engineering and reliability problems. Lead failure analysis of electrical and other systems and educate maintenance and production technicians after failure analysis. Maintain and update plant electrical drawings and files as needed.
cond_0451.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5+ Years of technical experience in a production environment
Project management and environmental experience
SAP experience
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering
Continuous Improvement experience using LEAN or Six Sigma concepts

cond_0526.intro: The Plant Engineering Manager is responsible for developing, executing, and managing activities aimed at maintaining and improving asset availability and reliability. This includes restoring equipment to base condition when deterioration occurs, supporting facility expansions and modifications, and managing plant mechanical and electrical support systems. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of electrical systems and reliability problems.
cond_0526.responsibilities:
Manage all assigned projects to ensure completion within approved schedule and budget
Manage capital equipment quoting, purchasing, installation, and startup processes
Direct and oversee assigned contractor personnel in project implementation activities
Support and ensure compliance with quality, environmental, business policies, and state standards
Develop standardized documentation including SOPs, training, and validation of equipment reliability
Plan and monitor capital investment expenditures
Establish key interfaces and build relationships with internal customers and team members in support of CAPEX project goals
Identify and manage relationships with preferred equipment manufacturers, specialists, and technical support consultants
Identify and correct chronic, repetitive, and costly electrical equipment and other systems problems
Support planned and unplanned turnarounds, outages, major electrical equipment overhauls, and routine and non-routine repairs
Provide electrical engineering support to maintenance and operations teams
Obtain information necessary for design improvement where inherent reliability is inadequate
Provide engineering support as needed and be on-call for critical plant or asset electrical or other systems failures
Work closely with manufacturing teams at all levels to resolve technical issues, applying engineering and technical skills to design, optimize, and troubleshoot electrical and other systems equipment
Improve equipment and system reliability, safety, and sustainability at minimum total cost
Perform technical analysis, testing, calculations, and evaluation of results to solve complex engineering and reliability problems
Lead failure analysis of electrical and other systems and equipment and educate maintenance and production technicians after failure analysis
Maintain and update plant electrical drawings and files as needed
